note: Temperature Gauge composable main chart — three modes cycle via the toolbar button (price, tool-only, compose). In compose mode the main canvas becomes a stage: promote any indicator from below to the main canvas, multiple indicators overlay on one Chart.js instance with alternating left/right y-axes, only the first indicator shows grid to reduce clutter. Right-click or long-press any sub-chart for the context menu: change color, glow effect, brightness slider, promote/demote, maximize, hide. Pills on the main canvas show each promoted indicator with its color, demote arrow, and a clear-all chip. Full state persists across reload: mode, promoted list, per-indicator brightness and glow.
